obligations.name: bind_workflow_stream
obligations.description: Fold every owned draft, graph, and revision inside one workflow stream.

obligations.name: authorize_workflow_access
obligations.description: Authorize against the workflow owner and conjunctive visibility scopes.

obligations.name: authorize_scope_binding
obligations.description: Validate initial visibility scopes against verified authority facts.

obligations.name: require_workflow
obligations.description: Require the selected workflow aggregate.

obligations.name: validate_draft_parent
obligations.description: Resolve a draft only inside its workflow stream.

obligations.name: validate_new_draft_parent
obligations.description: Resolve the owning workflow before creating a draft.

obligations.name: require_active_draft
obligations.description: Only active drafts can be edited, checked, published, or discarded.

obligations.name: validate_node_parent
obligations.description: Resolve a node only inside the selected draft and workflow stream.

obligations.name: validate_new_node_parent
obligations.description: Resolve the draft before adding a node.

obligations.name: require_active_node
obligations.description: Removed nodes cannot be replaced or removed again.

obligations.name: validate_edge_parent
obligations.description: Resolve an edge only inside the selected draft and workflow stream.

obligations.name: require_active_edge
obligations.description: Disconnected edges cannot be disconnected again.

obligations.name: derive_draft_authority
obligations.description: Drafts inherit the current workflow authority.

obligations.name: derive_revision_authority
obligations.description: Published revisions inherit immutable workflow authority metadata.

obligations.name: connect_draft_dag
obligations.description: Refuse missing, self, duplicate, or cyclic graph connections.

obligations.name: remove_unreferenced_node
obligations.description: Require explicit edge disconnection before node removal.

obligations.name: publish_draft_snapshot
obligations.description: Validate and materialize one canonical immutable revision snapshot and digest.

obligations.name: activate_owned_revision
obligations.description: Only a published revision already owned by this workflow stream can be activated.

obligations.name: partition_projection_by_auth
obligations.description: Materialize hidden tenant and exact optional-realm partitions with scoped reads.

obligations.name: filter_visible_workflows
obligations.description: Filter workflow rows by verified scope facts without conferring ownership.

obligations.name: filter_visible_drafts
obligations.description: Filter draft rows by inherited workflow authority.

obligations.name: filter_visible_revisions
obligations.description: Filter revision rows by inherited workflow authority.
